label: NIWA and research institutes develop catchment GIS modelling
summary: NIWA’s 2004–2006 programme progressed from the Stage I SPARROW toolbox to a tested ArcGIS CLUES pilot. The 2006 report documents a 2005 Environment Waikato test, integrated SPARROW, OVERSEER and Harris Consulting models, documented data inputs and limits on SPASMO’s spatial use.

sources.label: NIWA Stage I modelling report CHC2004-097 (2004)
NIWA Stage II catchment GIS modelling report, HAM2006-096 (2006)
